title: Localizing A[x_1..x_r]/(f_1x_1+...+f_rx_r-1) at f_i gives a polynomial ring over A_{f_i}
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $r\ge1$, $f_1,\dots,f_r\in A$, and $B=A[x_1,\dots,x_r]/(f_1x_1+\dots+f_rx_r-1)$. Fix $i\in\{1,\dots,r\}$; let $A_{f_i}$ be the localization of $A$ at $\{1,f_i,f_i^2,\dots\}$ and $B_{f_i}$ the localization of $B$ at the powers of the image of $f_i$, and regard $B_{f_i}$ as an $A_{f_i}$-algebra via the ring map $A_{f_i}	o B_{f_i}$, $a/f_i^e\mapsto a/f_i^e$ (induced by $A	o B$). Let $A_{f_i}[y_j:j
e i]$ be the polynomial ring over $A_{f_i}$ in the $r-1$ variables $y_j$, $j\in\{1,\dots,r\}\setminus\{i\}$. Then the $A_{f_i}$-algebra homomorphism $A_{f_i}[y_j:j
e i]	o B_{f_i}$ with $y_j\mapsto  ar x_j/1$ is an isomorphism; its inverse sends $ ar x_j/1\mapsto y_j$ for $j
e i$ and $ ar x_i/1\mapsto f_i^{-1} igl(1-\sum_{j
e i}f_jy_j igr)$.
